186474.overview: King Kong is a 1990 pinball machine designed by Data East, themed around the titular giant ape reeking havoc atop the Sears Tower in Chicago. Due to licensing issues the machine was never widely manufactured, and only 9 finished tables are known to have been made, making it one of the rarest pinball machines.

188260.overview: Kingpin was the last game made by Capcom and only a few were made before Capcom closed their doors. Designer Mark Ritchie was working on this game before Flipper Football was even started, but Flipper Football was rushed to production to precede it, making Kingpin the last game.

461924.overview: Kung Fu is a rare electromechanical machine released in 1975 by the Brazilian manufacturer LTD do Brasil. The table features various karate-themed and Bruce Lee-influenced artwork.

462197.overview:
The 1978 King Kong pinball machine is an exceptionally rare, solid-state table produced by LTD do Brasil. This Brazilian manufacturer was known for creating clones of popular American tables; the 1978 King Kong table was specifically a clone of Bally’s Aladdin’s Castle (1976).

The backglass artwork is heavily inspired by the 1976 King Kong movie poster featuring Jeff Bridges and Jessica Lange, depicting the gorilla being attacked by jets.

468585.overview:
This digital table recalls the events of the first film in the Kung Fu Panda series. Lifelong fan of the Furious Five, slacker panda Po unexpectedly becomes the prophesied Dragon Warrior, who uses kung fu skills to defeat the villainous Tai Lung.

Released as part of the Dreamworks Pinball pack for Zen Pinball Party for Apple Arcade on 3 September 2021, and subsequently released as DLC for Pinball FX on 15 December 2022.

As DreamWorks is currently owned by Universal Pictures, this table pack was produced as a continuation of Zen Studios' partnership with the firm following the Universal Pictures Classics mini-table pack.

468664.overview:
Sit behind the wheel and use K.I.T.T.’s superior technology to face off against the greatest threats on the road like K.A.R.R. Punch the Turbo Boost, activate Super Pursuit Mode, and engage Auto Cruise to let the table play automatically!

Released as part of the Universal Pinball: TV Classics pack for Pinball FX on 16 May 2024.

469015.overview: Embark on a journey to the homeland of the Titans to save mankind! Battle the Warbat, brave gravity storms, lead Kong to his throne, and survive this beautiful but deadly land.

472090.overview:
SLAMT1LT's version of Bally's 1979 table keeps the original playfield design and artwork, but makes a number of significant changes. Audio is improved, with players able to select different KISS songs to listen to whilst playing, the backglass has been changed, and two different gameplay modes have been added:

• God of Rock:  Score as many points as possible and climb the Fame Ladder to become the God Of Rock.

• Rock Frenzy: Keep the crowd happy by playing an exciting game.  Keep scoring to keep the Fame Ladder lights lit.  If they all go out the crowd will boo you off the stage and you lose the ball. 

These gameplay modes may be selected by holding down both flippers before starting the game.

472357.overview:
King of the Hill is an American animated sitcom created by Mike Judge and Greg Daniels that aired on Fox. The series follows the Hills, an American family who live in the fictional city of Arlen, Texas, as well as their neighbors, co-workers, relatives, classmates, friends, and acquaintances. The show's realistic approach seeks humor in the conventional and mundane aspects of everyday life, blue-collar workers, family conflicts, and the trials of puberty.

An original table for Visual Pinball X coded by MerlinRTP, with art and design by Joe Picasso, and a VR Room from Zandy's Arcade. Released on the Fourth of July 2025, the table incorporates artwork, video clips, audio and music from every God-fearing, honest American's favourite TV show.

472393.overview: A mod for Visual Pinball X of Data East's King Kong table from 1990.

477528.overview: A popular and original table for Future Pinball based on the 1980s TV series starring David Hasselhoff and a talking car. Released by Rom in 2012, the table has been modded several time since with updated physics, and was ported to Visual Pinball X in 2025 by Tombg.

480162.overview: In space no one can eat ice cream! Killer Klowns from Outer Space is an original table for Future Pinball based on the cult 1988 science fiction comedy horror film produced by the Chiodo Brothers. The premise of the film concerns evil extraterrestrials that resemble clowns arriving on Earth and invading a small town in order to capture, kill and harvest the human inhabitants for sustenance.

480189.overview: Released by Wild for Future Pinball in 2020, The King of Pop is a port of Marty02's "Michael Jackson" table for Visual Pinball X. The playfield is based on "Rock" (Gottlieb, 1985).

480947.overview:
Inspired by Capcom's 1991 beat 'em up game, The King of Dragons is an original game for Future Pinball by talented developers Wild and Popotte. At the start of the game, you have to choose a caracter (elf, dwarf, cleric, fighter or wizard) with the right flipper and confirm your choice with the left flipper (in order to see scenes of the game in a hologram).

Missions:
=========

In order to be the real and unique King of Dragons, you have to complete 5 missions.
- elf: you have to hit the right ramp x times, depending of settings - see below,
- fighter: you have to hit the left ramp x times, depending of settings - see below,
- dwarf: you have to make upper loop x times, depending of settings - see below,
- wizard: you have to enter right kicker x times, depending of settings - see below,
- cleric: you have to enter the left kicker 3 times. Before entering the kicker, you have to hit x drop targets, depending of settings - see below.

When you have completed these 5 missions, jackpot is activated. Each time you get the left or right ramp, the upper loop, the right or the left kicker, you get a jackpot. When you complete all these hits, you get the super jackpot and missions are reset. If you lose your ball without completing the hits, missions are reset too.

Sub missions:
=============
In order to lock balls for multiball, you have to complete four sub missions. 
- bumpers: you have to hit x times the bumpers, depending of settings - see below,
- left drop targets: you have to reset the bank x times, depending of settings - see below,
- targets: you have to hit all the targets x times, depending of settings - see below,
- dragon: you have to hit the dragon x times, depending of settings - see below.
When you complete these sub missions, you get some extra score.

Extra ball:
===========
You have to get 5 times the middle right kicker in order to get an extra ball. You can win only one extra ball per ball in play.

Multiball:
==========
In order to lock balls, you have to complete missions:
- for the first multiball (2 balls), you have to complete at least 2 sub missions. Each time you complete a sub mission, you can lock one ball.
